title: Graph-It-Live diagram spec
description: One level of the architecture (graph-it diagram --format diagram-spec): the exact nodes, layers, edges, cycles and rule violations a diagram may show. Draw nothing absent from it.

version.description: Bumped when a field changes meaning or goes away

workspace.description: Workspace folder name, never an absolute path

level.description: units: packages, else top-level folders; groups: the folders of one unit or folder

scope.description: "units", or the unit or folder key whose groups are listed

revision.description: Index revision the data comes from

date.description: Day of the indexed revision, when known

filters.description: View filters applied, e.g. "role library", "min. 3 imports"

caption.description: Header lines of the generated diagram: reuse them as the title and caption

layers.description: Ascending; layer 0 depends on no other node of the level and is drawn at the bottom

nodes.description: Every node of the level, sorted by key

key.description: Workspace-relative folder; edges, layers and cycles refer to it

label.description: Name to draw: package name, else folder

internalEdgeCount.description: Import file pairs inside the node

role.description: Units level only: declared in graphit.architecture.json, else inferred

edges.description: Every dependency between two nodes, sorted by from then to

fileEdgeCount.description: Distinct importing file pairs: the edge weight

kind.description: down: to a lower layer; upward: to the same or a higher layer; cycle: both ends in one cycle

rules.description: Names of the rules its file pairs break

accepted.description: Every violating pair of the edge is in the baseline

violations.description: Rule-breaking file pairs between two nodes (graph-it diagram --rules), those the baseline accepts, and the broken rules
